narrative_goal: Show that the maximum long-term capital gains tax rate has ranged from 15% to 35% since 1960 and is currently 20%, with Biden proposing a rise to 39.6% for those earning over $1 million.
intent_en: Trace the maximum long-term capital gains tax rate from 1960 through 2021 and compare the current rate with the proposed rate for high earners.
